life.zh: 他冒着生命危险救了我的命。

universe.zh: 我们的世界只不过是宇宙的一小部分。

world.zh: 我们的世界只不过是宇宙的一小部分。

believe.zh: 我们有充分的理由相信这是真的。

believe.zh: 我相信这种药对你的病情有帮助。

money.text: The man cheated the old woman out of her ____.

brother.zh: 我的弟弟(或者哥哥)从树上掉下来摔断了腿。

night.text: This is the doctor whom I spoke of last ____.

night.text: Thank you very much for the wonderful dinner last ____.

impossible.zh: 在一天之内完成它几乎是不可能的。

impossible.text: It's absolutely ____ for me to go on like this.
impossible.zh: 让我像这样继续下去是绝对不可能的。

member.text: He is a ____ of the tennis club in our school.

member.zh: 我是网球俱乐部的会员。

tennis.zh: 他是学校网球俱乐部的成员。

child.zh: 你可以问问在那里玩的孩子。

child.text: You can ask the ____ who is playing over there.
child.zh: 你可以问在那里玩耍的小孩。

easily.zh: 灯光太暗了，我没法阅读。

easily.zh: 晚上吃多了容易做噩梦。

really.text: It is ____ marvelous of you to remember my birthday.
really.zh: 你还记得我的生日，那真是太好了。

really.text: I'm ____ sorry. I seem to have lost your umbrella.
really.zh: 我真的很抱歉，我好像弄丢了你的雨伞。

concept.text: I really like the ____ of this website.
concept.zh: 我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。

concept.text: They implemented a communication policy so as to promote their new ____.
concept.zh: 他们到位了实行新概念的广告策略。

website.text: I really like the concept of this ____.

website.zh: 这个网站的介面没有甚么新意，但是却很简洁。

ask.text: I don't dare ____ the boss to borrow the car.

ask.zh: 会成功的男人必须请求妻子让他离开出外打拼。

town.text: I'd like to leave this ____ and never come back.
town.zh: 我希望离开这个村子并且再也不要回来。

town.text: I wouldn't buy a house in that part of ____.
town.zh: 我不想在城镇的那个地方买房

celebrate.text: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and ____.
celebrate.zh: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。

danger.text: You're in ____ of becoming a good man.
danger.zh: 你恐怕会变成一个好人哦。

danger.text: The old bridge is in ____ of collapse.

overcome.text: How to ____ the high value of the yen is a big problem.
overcome.zh: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。

overcome.text: I've found a way to ____ my habit of always picking fault with others.
overcome.zh: 我想办法克服了对别人吹毛求疵的毛病。

forget.text: Don't ____ to fill in your name on the form.
forget.zh: 别忘了在名单上写上你自己的名字。

forget.text: Don't ____ to put a stamp on your letter.
forget.zh: 别忘了在你的信上贴张邮票。

sorry.text: I'm ____ I don't agree with you on that matter.
sorry.zh: 很抱歉那个问题我不赞成你。

sorry.text: I'm really ____. I seem to have lost your umbrella.
sorry.zh: 我真的很抱歉，我好像弄丢了你的雨伞。

accept.zh: 我不知道是否该同意或拒绝。

accept.text: Please ____ my sincere congratulations on your success today.
accept.zh: 请接受我对您今天的成功最诚挚的祝贺。

invitation.text: It is very impolite of her to decline our ____.
invitation.zh: 她拒绝我们的邀请很不礼貌。

invitation.zh: 许多人拒绝了欢迎会的邀请。

day.zh: 在一天之内完成它几乎是不可能的。

day.zh: 他脾气这么坏，早晚会惹麻烦。

away.text: Don't throw ____ this magazine. I haven't read it yet.
away.zh: 这本杂志不要扔。我还没看呢。

away.text: He is the last person to give ____ the secret.

importance.text: This is considered to be a matter of great ____.

importance.zh: 你现在不好好储蓄金钱的话，终有一天会后悔的。

disturb.text: I'll do my best not to ____ your studying.
disturb.zh: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。

disturb.text: I'll try not to ____ you while you're studying.
disturb.zh: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。

difficult.zh: 我早上六时之前总是起不了床。

difficult.zh: 我们觉得很难决定买哪一个。

car.zh: 根本不可能买到这么贵的车子。

happy.text: I'll be very ____ if I can serve you.
happy.zh: 能为你服务我会感到非常高兴。

happy.text: I wish you a long and ____ married life.
happy.zh: 祝你们婚姻长长久久、永浴爱河。

news.text: I perceive by your face that you have good ____.
news.zh: 我从你的表情猜到你有好消息。

news.text: He would be very glad to hear the ____.
news.zh: 他听到这个消息，一定会很高兴。

success.zh: 没有你帮忙，计划就不能成功了。

success.text: They helped one another to make the school festival a ____.
success.zh: 他们互帮互助，把校庆搞得很成功。

story.text: This ____ is by far more interesting than that one.
story.zh: 这个故事比那个故事有趣得多。

story.text: We've come to the conclusion that this is a true ____.
story.zh: 我们的结论就是，那个传言是真的。

accident.text: We have to make a close analysis of the ____.
accident.zh: 我们要详细的分析一下意外发生的前因后果。

accident.zh: 在去剧院的路上，我看到了一起车祸。

hour.text: I can't absorb all of the lesson in an ____.
hour.zh: 我不能一小时内彻底的了解那堂课程。

hour.text: I finished the work in less than an ____.
hour.zh: 我用不到一小时就完成了这个工作。

homework.zh: 我做完我的功课后，就读这本书。

homework.zh: 家庭作业是学习中很重要的一部分。

write.zh: 请把您的个人地址写给我。

write.zh: 她没能说服他为她写首歌。

tell.zh: 我会告诉她开会的时候说些什么。

tell.zh: 我没有勇气把事实告诉她。

beautiful.zh: 她不仅漂亮，而且对每个人都很好。

beautiful.text: It is my pleasure to wait for a ____ lady.
beautiful.zh: 等待一位漂亮的姑娘是我的荣幸。

beginning.text: I think that we're just ____ to understand the problem.
beginning.zh: 我认为我们刚开始了解这个问题。

beginning.text: I hope this is the ____ of a beautiful friendship.
beginning.zh: 希望这是美好友谊的开始。

speak.zh: 她现在很忙，不能和你谈话。

speak.zh: 他绝不是说人坏话的人。

understand.zh: 我不是很清楚这个句子的意思。

understand.zh: 一个不懂你的人不一定就是一个笨蛋。

critical.zh: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

satellite.zh: 选择合适的卫星图做为底图

satellite.text: The moon is the earth's only ____.
satellite.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。

hearing.zh: 我只是想要听听你的嗓音。

hearing.zh: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。

foreign.zh: 我认为大家都应该学另外一种语言。

temperature.text: There was a sudden drop in the ____ last night.
temperature.zh: 昨天晚上气温突然下降

economy.text: The town developed into the center of the ____.
economy.zh: 这座城镇发展成为了一个经济中心。

economy.text: A stable ____ is the aim of every government.
economy.zh: 经济繁荣稳定，是每个政府都想达到的目标。

opportunity.text: I must take the ____ to improve my language ability.
opportunity.zh: 我要借机提升我的语言能力。

opportunity.text: I decided to take the ____ to go and visit him.
opportunity.zh: 我决定顺便去看望看望他。

usual.text: He put the key on the desk as ____.
usual.zh: 他跟平时一样把钥匙放在书桌上。

usual.text: He put the key on the table as ____.
usual.zh: 他习惯性地将钥匙放在了桌子上。

nearly.text: You ____ poked me in the eye with your pencil.
nearly.zh: 你的铅笔差点戳到我的眼睛了。

nearly.text: I ____ left my umbrella on the train.
nearly.zh: 我几乎把我的雨伞忘在火车上。

knowledge.text: He is an industrious student to the best of my ____.
knowledge.zh: 就我所知，他是个很用功的学生。

knowledge.text: To the best of my ____, she's hard to please.
knowledge.zh: 据我所知，她很难被取悦。

rich.text: Her life goal is to marry a ____ man.
rich.zh: 她的人生目标就是找个有钱的老公。

rich.text: I am not too ____, too fat or too happy.
rich.zh: 我不太有钱、不太胖，也不太快乐。

virtue.text: She became rich by ____ of hard work and good business sense.
virtue.zh: 她凭着努力和生意头脑成了富翁。

appearance.text: Judging from his ____, he must be a rich man.
appearance.zh: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

appearance.text: An eclipse of the sun is a rare ____.

unite.text: Oceans do not so much divide the world as ____ it.
unite.zh: 海洋不是将世界分隔开来，而是将世界连接起来

unite.text: The president called on the people to ____ in fighting poverty and disease.
unite.zh: 总统呼吁全国民众在对抗贫穷或疾病的时候，一定要团结一致。

painting.text: This ____ is worth a great deal of money.
I can't look at this ____ without thinking of my mom.
painting.zh: 我无法看着这幅画而不想起我母亲。

particularly.text: He's just a normal junior high school student, not ____ intelligent.
particularly.zh: 他只不过是个普普通通的中学生，不算特别聪明。

particularly.text: This new word is ____ important for us.
particularly.zh: 这些生词对我们特别重要。

cancer.text: I'd like to have a test for breast ____.
cancer.zh: 我想检查一下我是否患了乳癌。

cancer.text: Many ____ patients lose their hair because of the chemotherapy.
cancer.zh: 很多癌症患者都因为化疗而脱发。

previous.text: I would like to retract my ____ statement.
previous.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

previous.text: I had lost a camera the ____ day.
previous.zh: 我前一天丢了一台相机。

careful.text: Be ____ when you pass through the street's busy traffic.
careful.zh: 当你穿越交通繁忙的街道时要小心注意。

careful.text: You should be more ____ with what you speak about.
careful.zh: 你应该更注意你说的话。

pollution.text: Air ____ will be a threat to our survival.
pollution.zh: 空气污染将会威胁我们的生存。

pollution.text: Public feeling against air ____ has at last become vocal.
pollution.zh: 公众终于对关于空气污染的意见直言不讳了。

admire.text: She stopped before the mirror to ____ herself.
admire.zh: 她在镜前停下脚步，自我欣赏了一番。

remember.text: It is really marvelous of you to ____ my birthday.
remember.zh: 你还记得我的生日，那真是太好了。

remember.text: I can't for the life of me ____ her address.
remember.zh: 她的住址无论如何也想不起来。

remind.text: You ____ me of a boy I used to know.
remind.zh: 你让我想起我过去认识的一个男孩。

remind.text: Please ____ me to mail the report tomorrow.
remind.zh: 请提醒我明天把报告寄了。

animal.text: Man is the only ____ that can make use of fire.
animal.zh: 人是唯一会使用火的动物。

animal.text: A tiger is a very ferocious kind of ____.
animal.zh: 老虎是一种非常凶猛的动物。

factory.text: Possibly the ____ will be closed down next week.
There is no ____ in this village.

journal.text: My dad keeps a ____ every day.

rural.text: It seems the ____ area will be developed on a large scale.
rural.zh: 农村好像要大规模发展了。

owe.text: I ____ it you that I am still alive.
I ____ my success to his help.

appointment.text: He is always on time for an ____.
I have an ____ with him at six.

conference.text: The ____ will be held in a specially selected church.
conference.zh: 会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。

conference.text: Tom is waiting for you in the ____ room.

lend.text: You should have known better than to ____ him money.
lend.zh: 早知如此，就不应该借钱给他。

lend.text: If you have any money, please ____ me some.
lend.zh: 如果你有钱的话，借点给我吧。

depend.text: You may ____ on him to help you.
depend.zh: 你或许可以依靠他来帮助你。

depend.text: I ____ on the alarm clock to wake up on time every morning.
depend.zh: 每天早上我都要靠闹钟来按时叫醒我。

information.text: I will provide you all the necessary ____.
information.zh: 我会把所有有用的信息提供给您的。

information.text: I'll provide you with all the necessary ____.
information.zh: 我会给你所有必要的信息。

theory.text: I can't find a single flaw in his ____.
theory.zh: 我在他的理论中找不到任何问题。

theory.text: This ____ is too difficult for me to comprehend.
theory.zh: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。

accurate.text: Most important of all a clock has to be ____.
accurate.zh: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。

accurate.text: It's not your mother tongue, so your pronunciation will never be ____.
accurate.zh: 因为它不是你的母语，你的发音会永远不准。

impression.text: You never get a second chance to make a first ____.
impression.zh: 你永远没有第二次机会去打造第一印象。

impression.text: What you said left a deep ____ on me.
impression.zh: 你说的话给我留下了很深刻的印象。

aware.text: He paid the prostitute the fee without being ____ of the surveillance camera.
aware.zh: 他在不知有监控录像的情况下支付了妓女服务费用。

aware.text: I became ____ of someone looking at me.
aware.zh: 我感觉到有人在看着我。

serious.text: He could not come because of his ____ illness.
Carelessness can lead to a ____ accident.
serious.zh: 粗心大意可能导致严重的事故。

grandfather.text: My ____ is five times as old as I am.
grandfather.zh: 祖父的年龄比我大五倍。

grandfather.text: My ____ is fond of taking a walk early in the morning.
grandfather.zh: 我的爷爷喜欢大清早的散步。

restaurant.text: I can't afford to eat in such an expensive ____.
restaurant.zh: 我吃不起这么贵的餐馆。

restaurant.text: There is a good ____ in front of the station.
restaurant.zh: 车站前有一家不错的餐厅。

loss.text: I was at a ____ as to what to say.
Mary is at a ____ what to say to him.
loss.zh: 玛莉不知道该和他说甚么才好。

creature.text: A dragon is a ____ of fancy.
creature.zh: 龙是人幻想出来的动物。

relation.text: In ____ to this, I am to blame.
relation.zh: 关于这件事，我必须负上责任。

relation.text: I had a lot to say in ____ to that affair.
relation.zh: 关于那件事我有很多话要说。

shelf.text: He put the books on the ____ out of order.
shelf.zh: 他胡乱把书本放在架上。

shelf.text: Put the book back on the ____.

certain.text: It's still not ____ who's going to win this match.
certain.zh: 谁能赢这场比赛还说不定。

certain.text: I do not know for ____ when he will come.
certain.zh: 我不确定他什么时候来。

event.text: I never drink unless there's a big ____ of some kind.
event.zh: 除非是大活动，否则我是从不喝酒的。

event.text: By the shower of time, people have forgotten this ____.
event.zh: 在时间的洗礼下，这事件已经被人们遗忘。

guilt.text: It doesn't matter whether she admits her ____ or not.
guilt.zh: 她认罪不认罪都没关系。

guilt.text: I'm afraid he will never admit his ____.
guilt.zh: 恐怕他永远也不会承认自己的罪行。

ceiling.text: The device is attached fast to the ____.
ceiling.zh: 装置被牢牢地固定在天花板上。

ceiling.text: There is a fly on the ____.

death.text: The cause of his ____ still remains a mystery.
death.zh: 他的死因仍然是一个谜。

death.text: I'm a deeply religious man and believe in life after ____.
death.zh: 我是一个虔诚的教徒，我相信死后的生命。

president.text: They decided to choose him to be ____.
Zelensky is a democratically elected ____ of a sovereign country.
president.zh: 泽伦斯基是一位主权国家的民选总统。

apply.text: In order to ____, you have to go in person.
apply.zh: 要申请的话，你得亲自去。

apply.text: You can't ____ this rule to every case.
apply.zh: 你不能把这规则应用在所有事上。

discussion.text: They came up with a plan after a long ____.
discussion.zh: 他们终于在漫长的讨论之后得出了一个计划。

discussion.text: You'd better avoid ____ of religion and politics.
discussion.zh: 你最好别提到宗教和政治这些话题。

shirt.text: I think it's time for me to wash this ____.
shirt.zh: 我觉得是时候洗这件上衣了。

shirt.text: The second button of your ____ is coming off.
shirt.zh: 你衬衫的第二粒衣钮好像快要掉下来了。

idea.text: I have no ____ of how to send a fax.
I have no ____ of what's going on in there.
idea.zh: 我不清楚这里发生了什么事？

defend.text: To ____ ourselves, we had to tell a lie.
defend.zh: 为了保护自己，我们只好说谎。

defend.text: That was the only way we could ____ ourselves against all this terrible shooting.
defend.zh: 那是我们在枪林弹雨中自保的唯一方法。

weak.text: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is ____.
He was a ____ and delicate child.
weak.zh: 他以前是个柔弱的小孩。

delicate.text: Indeed she is young and beautiful, but she is in ____ health.
delicate.zh: 她确实年轻貌美，但她体质娇弱。

delicate.text: He was a weak and ____ child.
delicate.zh: 他以前是个柔弱的小孩。

suddenly.text: The bus stopped ____ in the middle of the street.
suddenly.zh: 巴士突然在路中心停了下来。

suddenly.text: I don't know at all why he quit his job ____.
suddenly.zh: 我完全不明白他为甚么会突然辞职。

afford.text: I can't ____ to eat in such an expensive restaurant.
afford.zh: 我吃不起这么贵的餐馆。

afford.text: I can't ____ to buy such an expensive car.
afford.zh: 我买不起这么贵的轿车。

lawyer.text: I have a feeling you'll be a very good ____.
lawyer.zh: 我感觉你将来会成为一名优秀的律师。

lawyer.text: I'm not saying anything until I speak with my ____.
lawyer.zh: 在我与律师谈过之前，我什么都不会说。

football.text: The ____ game is now on the air.
football.zh: 电视台现在正在播放足球赛。

football.text: He hurt his foot, he can't play ____ anymore.
football.zh: 他脚受伤了，不能再继续踢足球。

accuracy.text: I began to doubt the ____ of his statement.
accuracy.zh: 我开始怀疑他陈述的准确性。

accuracy.text: There's no need to worry about ____ this time; just eyeball it.
accuracy.zh: 现在精确度已经不重要了，你目测一下就好。

statement.text: I would like to retract my previous ____.
statement.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

statement.text: I began to doubt the accuracy of his ____.
statement.zh: 我开始怀疑他陈述的准确性。

boundary.text: There is a fence marking the ____ between our yard and the neighbor's.
boundary.zh: 我家和邻居家以院子之间的篱笆为分界线。

yard.text: Give him an inch and he'll take a ____.
He is waiting for me in the ____.

excitement.text: She turned over the page with ____.

refer.text: ____ to the dictionary as often as possible.

hungry.text: Please give me something to eat. I am so ____.
hungry.zh: 可以给我一点吃的吗？我快饿疯了啦。

hungry.text: I wasn't very ____, so I decided to eat later.
hungry.zh: 因为我不是很饿，所以我决定晚点吃。

receive.text: I'll pay you back once I ____ my salary.
receive.zh: 一领到工资就把钱还给你。

receive.text: It is more blessed to give than to ____.

cute.text: The girl who works at the bakery is ____.
cute.zh: 在面包房工作的姑娘很可爱。

cute.text: I remember him as a ____, bright little boy.
cute.zh: 我印象中的他是个可爱聪明的小男孩。

clothing.text: The color of this ____ is neither red nor orange.
clothing.zh: 这衣服颜色既不是红色，也不是橙色。

clothing.text: I can provide my family with food and ____.
clothing.zh: 我可以给我的家庭提供衣食。

beauty.text: That girl is arrogant because of her ____.
beauty.zh: 那位女生对自己的美貌感到很骄傲。

beauty.text: There is no doubt as to her ____.
beauty.zh: 她的美貌是毫无疑问的。

operate.text: I don't know how to ____ this computer.
operate.zh: 我不知道怎么操作这台电脑.

operate.text: The doctor decided to ____ at once.

agreement.text: There is not one person who is in ____ with the plan.
agreement.zh: 赞成计划的人一个也没有。

agreement.text: We made an ____ to meet exactly at ten.
agreement.zh: 我们彼此同意在十点整见面。

environment.text: We ought to do our best not to pollute our ____.
environment.zh: 我们应该尽力不要污染环境。

environment.text: Skilled soldiers know how to use their ____ as a weapon.
environment.zh: 熟练的士兵知道怎么以他们的环境为武器。

population.text: An aging ____ will require more spending on health care.
population.zh: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

population.text: The ____ of the world will double before long.
population.zh: 世界人口将在不久的将来增加两倍。

disappear.text: The fog began to ____ around ten o'clock.
disappear.zh: 雾在十时左右开始散了。

decision.text: His age didn't enter into our ____ not to employ him.
decision.zh: 我们决定不录用他时，并没有考虑他的年龄问题。

decision.text: I'd like some time to consider before I make a ____.
decision.zh: 我想花点时间斟酌斟酌再作决定。

flour.text: We need ____, sugar and eggs to make this cake.
flour.zh: 我们需要面粉、砂糖和鸡蛋来做这个蛋糕。

flour.text: ____ is one of those products you should always have in your kitchen.
flour.zh: 面粉是那些你始终应该储备在厨房里的产品之一。

borrow.text: I don't dare ask the boss to ____ the car.
I will not ____ money from those people.
borrow.zh: 我是不会向那些人借钱的。

clearly.text: I think to ____ distinguish opinion from fact is important.
clearly.zh: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

clearly.text: You can see the city view ____ from the office window.
clearly.zh: 透过办公室的窗户可以清晰地看见城市的风景。

together.text: You're the one who suggested that we do that ____.
together.zh: 你是那个建议我们一起做那件事的人。

together.text: We need to band ____ to beat the enemy.
together.zh: 我们必须团结起来才能战胜敌人。

rarely.text: It's not wrong, but it's ____ written like that.
rarely.zh: 写的没错，不过很少那么说。

rarely.text: English people ____ talk to strangers in the train.
rarely.zh: 英国人很少在火车上和陌生人搭讪。

approve.text: That's why I don't ____ of your plan.
approve.zh: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。

approve.text: I cannot ____ of your going out with him.

bucket.text: Well, I can cross that off my ____ list.
bucket.zh: 太好了，死前心愿又完成了一样。

bucket.text: He collected an entire ____ of water.

basketball.text: I've always wanted to be a professional ____ player.
basketball.zh: 我一直想成为一名职业篮球运动员。

basketball.text: Two years ago I could not play ____ at all.
basketball.zh: 两年前我完全不懂得打篮球。

wonderful.text: Thank you very much for the ____ dinner last night.
wonderful.zh: 非常感谢您昨晚美妙的晚餐。

wonderful.text: This is the most ____ present I have ever received.
wonderful.zh: 这是我收过最好的礼物了。

grief.text: She was filled with deep ____ to hear of her father's sudden death.
grief.zh: 她得知父亲突然离世，不禁心如刀割。

mile.text: My house is only a ____ from here.
mile.zh: 我的家离这里只有一英里。

mile.text: The post office is half a ____ away.

transportation.text: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public ____.
transportation.zh: 这间酒店的交通位置很方便。

transportation.text: The ____ in this city is very convenient.
transportation.zh: 这个城市的交通方便得很。

clever.text: He may be ____, but he is not very helpful.
clever.zh: 他很聪明，但却不太帮得上忙。

clever.text: Although he may be ____, he is not wise.
clever.zh: 他只不过是有点小聪明。

spend.text: I often ____ my leisure time listening to the radio.
spend.zh: 我常常在我的闲暇时候听广播。

spend.text: That is as much as I dare ____ on it.

successful.text: Their common aim was to make the project ____.
successful.zh: 这些人共同的目标是把这个项目做成功。

successful.text: If there is somebody to back me up, the business will be ____.
successful.zh: 如果有人支持的话，生意是会成功的。

convey.text: His words ____ nothing at all to me.
convey.zh: 他的话对我来说没有任何意义。

valid.text: This passport is ____ for five years.
valid.zh: 这本护照的有用期限为五年。

valid.text: This ticket is ____ for three days.

phenomenon.text: An eclipse of the moon is a rare ____.
phenomenon.zh: 月食是一种罕见的现象。

phenomenon.text: The aurora is a ____ characteristic of the polar regions.
phenomenon.zh: 极光是极地特有的自然现象。

talent.text: Musical ____ can be developed if it's properly trained.
talent.zh: 如果训练得当的话，音乐才能是可以培养出来的。

talent.text: To be honest, he doesn't have any musical ____.
talent.zh: 说实话，他没有任何音乐天分。

tomato.text: Put the ____ salad in the refrigerator.
tomato.zh: 把蕃茄沙拉放进冰箱里。

tomato.text: The ____ is subject to a number of diseases.
tomato.zh: 番茄容易遭受很多病害。

poem.text: She had no difficulty in learning the ____ by heart.
poem.zh: 她轻而易举的就把诗背熟了。

poem.text: I want to write a ____ for you.

newspaper.text: I always have a look at the ____ before breakfast.
newspaper.zh: 我经常在早饭前看一眼报纸。

newspaper.text: A magazine can tell more about a story than a ____.
newspaper.zh: 杂志比报纸报导得更深入。

policy.text: This measure is in accord with our ____.
policy.zh: 这个议案合符我们的政策内容。

policy.text: Honesty is not always the best ____.
policy.zh: 诚实不总是最好的策略。

anticipate.text: We do not ____ their buying a new car.
anticipate.zh: 我们认为他们不会买新车。

anticipate.text: I ____ that there will be trouble.

belief.text: I have a firm ____ in his innocence.
His behavior is contrary to his ____.
belief.zh: 他的行为和他的信念背道而驰。

legendary.text: Bill is still a ____ figure in this company.
legendary.zh: Bill 在这间公司仍然是个传奇人物。

consideration.text: The first thing you have to take into ____ is time.
consideration.zh: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

consideration.text: We should have taken the schedule into ____.
consideration.zh: 我们本该考虑一下行程。

athlete.text: That ____ won three times in a row in this tournament.
athlete.zh: 那位选手在这次比赛中取得了三连胜。

skiing.text: It is said that she is an expert in ____.
We can enjoy ____ here all the year round.
skiing.zh: 在这里我们整年都能享受到滑雪的乐趣。

diamond.text: This ____ ring is too extravagant for me.
diamond.zh: 我觉得这钻石戒指太奢侈了。

diamond.text: This might not be a genuine ____.

difference.text: I need a week to adjust to the time ____.
difference.zh: 我需要一个星期来倒时差。

difference.text: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the ____.
difference.zh: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。

possibility.text: There is not much ____ of his coming on time.
possibility.zh: 他十有八九不会准时来。

possibility.text: There's a ____ that you'll have to do that.
possibility.zh: 你有可能不得不那么做。

disease.text: This medicine will cure you of your skin ____.
disease.zh: 这药可以治疗你的皮肤病。

disease.text: The number of people suffering from heart ____ has increased.
disease.zh: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。

certainly.text: The weatherman's forecast is almost ____ wrong.
